article.title: 君
article.part: Persona y conversación — 人称・会話
article.chapter: Pronombres, títulos y deixis social — 人称表現・呼称・社会的直示

claims.summary: 君 is a second-person form that can mean 'you', but its usage depends on social relationship. It appears mainly towards close, equal or lower-status individuals and can sound masculine, affectionate or condescending in certain styles.
君 is explicitly presented as the person being addressed in the question '¿Qué piensas?'
君 can be combined with particles such as 君は, 君が, and 君の, but Japanese typically prefers names, titles, or omission when the interlocutor is clear.
